start: Owner signed in, gym online; Members, Import from Excel; a member sheet with 12 columns

user_sees: The columns are matched by themselves, no button
"We matched them from the column names and what is in them."
must_not: A phone number or name sent to the AI
The import blocked while the AI thinks

steps.action: Check the column list and change any that are wrong
user_sees: Each column with the field it was matched to; unneeded ones say "AI says this column is not needed, so it is not kept."
must_not: A column matched to a field not in the list
Member data changed by the AI's answer

start: Owner; the gym already matched 20 sheets today (the normal daily limit)

user_sees: Matching by hand, with the words "Today's AI matches are used up. Match the columns yourself, or try tomorrow."
must_not: The import stuck
A 21st AI read taken

steps.action: Pick a sheet with 61 columns on another day
must_not: A crash or a blank column list

steps.action: Open the demo gym and pick a sheet
user_sees: Matching by hand ("AI matching is not on in the demo gym.")
must_not: The demo sheet sent to the AI

start: Owner; HQ set this gym's AI matching limit to 0

must_not: An AI read taken while the gym's limit is 0

steps.action: HQ sets the limit back to 20; pick a sheet again
user_sees: The columns are matched by themselves again
must_not: The old 0 kept after HQ changed it

user_sees: "The AI did not answer. Match the columns yourself." and matching by hand
must_not: A success shown with no matches

start: Owner; a sheet with names, mobiles, emails, addresses and ID numbers

must_not: A mobile, email or ID number in what the AI is shown
A name or address shown to the AI other than as [name] / [address]
Anything from the file kept on the server

start: Staff member signed in; Import from Excel; a member sheet

user_sees: Matching by hand (the server answers "Only the owner can use AI matching.")
must_not: The sheet sent to the AI for a staff login
An AI read taken from the gym's daily limit

start: Staff member whose sign-in key has ended

user_sees: Matching by hand; the server answers "Sign in first."
must_not: An AI read for an unknown key
A crash

start: Staff member; the owner makes this person an owner

steps.action: Sign in again and pick a sheet
user_sees: The columns are matched by themselves
must_not: Still refused after becoming an owner

steps.action: The owner changes the person back to staff; pick a sheet
must_not: AI matching still on for a staff login

start: Staff member; a sheet with members' phone numbers

must_not: Any cell of the sheet leaving the browser for the AI
